decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Buried Alive and Lotus Petal, allowing for the early casting of powerful threats like Arclight Phoenix and Demilich. The deck is equipped with disruption through cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes a suite of cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards and maintain card advantage. The deck also utilizes efficient removal options like Lightning Bolt and Gut Shot to remove opposing threats. Overall, the main goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive plays.

The key concept of this deck is to use Cascade mechanics to swarm the board with creatures and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck focuses on casting spells with Cascade, such as Violent Outburst, to generate card advantage and put pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes the power of Shardless Agent to further increase card advantage and control the game. The inclusion of counterspells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute provides protection while Crashing Footfalls and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes provide additional threats to dominate the board. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and maintain control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures into play from the graveyard, utilizing cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to cheat creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Grief and Unmask to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also incorporates ramp with cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual to speed up the reanimation process. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupt their strategy to secure victory.

This deck is a UWx Control deck in the Legacy format. The key concept is to control the opponent's actions and card advantage using cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. It includes various removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats. The deck also has counterspells such as Force of Will and Spell Pierce for additional control. It uses cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to smooth out draws and find the necessary cards. The deck also has a small red splash for cards like Blood Moon and Island','','');">Volcanic Island.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing powerful control cards like Force of Will, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Swords to Plowshares to manage the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes card advantage and manipulation tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for key cards and maintain a consistent game plan. Additionally, the deck has an element of ramp and card recursion with Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Life from the Loam to ensure a strong late game presence and resource advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to use efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, alongside disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, to apply early pressure on the opponent and disrupt their game plan. Canadian Threshold focuses on using cheap spells and cards that can help fill up the graveyard for cards like Murktide Regent. The deck aims to control the board by countering threats and removing key cards while quickly closing out the game with aggressive creatures and burn spells.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Seasoned Dungeoneer. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void and Chrome Mox, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and pressure the opponent into making suboptimal plays. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Touch the Spirit Realm also provides flexibility and additional ways to gain an advantage in the matchup.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the combo of Paradigm Shift and Thassa's Oracle in order to win the game instantly. The deck uses cards like Force of Will and Pact of Negation to protect the combo from disruption, while also utilizing cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Thought Lash to control the opponent's hand and draw potential. The inclusion of Chalice of the Void and Hullbreacher further disrupt the opponent's game plan, allowing the player to set up their win condition effectively.

This deck focuses on aggression and tempo control by utilizing cheap creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler along with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will. It aims to pressure the opponent early on with creatures while disrupting their game plan with counterspells and removal spells. The deck also has access to card selection with Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain consistency and keep the pressure on the opponent. Additionally, it has land destruction in the form of Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana development.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the necessary combo pieces to execute the Doomsday win condition, utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal to generate mana quickly. Thassa's Oracle is a key card in this combo, along with Doomsday itself. The deck includes various cards for protection and card selection, such as Force of Will and Brainstorm. The goal is to set up the perfect sequence of cards with Doomsday, allowing Thassa's Oracle to win the game when its ETB trigger resolves.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 deck is to utilize the Dark Depths combo. The deck includes cards like Crop Rotation, Sylvan Library, and Green Sun's Zenith to search for essential pieces of the combo. Legolas's Quick Reflexes can be used to untap the Dark Depths token, enabling a fast win condition. The deck also features utility creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer for additional search and protection. Lands like Karakas and Sejiri Steppe provide protection for key creatures, while Wasteland and Mox Diamond disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to quickly create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck utilizes cards like Crop Rotation, Green Sun's Zenith, and Elvish Reclaimer to tutor and search for the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect the combo. The inclusion of cards like Knight of the Reliquary and Mox Diamond adds versatility and acceleration to the deck's strategy of winning through the Dark Depths combo.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to quickly disrupt and lock down the opponent's game plan while ramping up aggression with powerful dragons. By utilizing cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Blood Moon, it aims to slow down the opponent's spells and mana development. At the same time, the deck is able to deploy threats like Broadside Bombardiers, Goblin Rabblemaster, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting the opponent while setting up a fast clock to win the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Ghalta, Atraxa, Archon of Cruelty, and Griselbrand using cards like Faithless Looting, Entomb, and Unmask, then bringing them back into play with spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The goal is to combo off and reanimate a giant threat early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures and disrupting their game plan. The deck leverages the graveyard as a resource to execute its game plan and win the game through an explosive reanimation strategy.

This deck revolves around the concept of generating a large number of spells in a single turn to build up storm count and win the game. The deck achieves this by utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to generate additional mana, and cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find the necessary pieces. Key cards include Tendrils of Agony, which deals damage equal to the storm count, and Lórien Revealed and Gaea's Will, which allow for additional spell casting and mana generation. The overall goal is to play a high number of spells in a single turn to overwhelm the opponent and win with Tendrils of Agony.

The key concept of the deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful control elements to apply pressure and disrupt opponents. The deck focuses on generating efficient card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Dragon's Rage Channeler while maintaining a strong tempo with Daze and Wasteland. The deck also has access to powerful removal spells such as Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out to handle threats. The main objective is to quickly deploy threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent while controlling the opponent's board state with counterspells and removal.
